author: Stunning Couches LLC
description: Local stdio MCP server for prizepicksapi.com: PrizePicks lines, goblin and demon tiers, line history, graded results. Keyless demo and payout tools.
name: PrizePicks API

tools.name: demo_projections
tools.description: Fictional sample PrizePicks projections with the exact live schema (is_demo: true). Use to learn the fields before calling live data. No key.

league.description: League code, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, CFB, SOCCER. Comma-separate several.

stat.description: Exact market name, for example Points or Pass Yards.

tier.description: Only lines with this tier on a selection.

limit.description: Rows per page (1-200, or up to 1000 with view=compact).

tools.name: demo_line_history
tools.description: Fictional line history for a demo projection id such as demo_nba_001. No key.

tools.name: demo_changes
tools.description: Fictional change-feed events (offer.changed etc.) in the live schema. No key.

league.description: League code, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, CFB, SOCCER. Comma-separate several.

tools.name: payout_table
tools.description: Official PrizePicks standard entry payout multipliers (power and flex) with derived break-even probabilities. Real reference data, no key. Goblin, demon and adjusted-odds lines pay differently and are not estimated.

tools.name: credit_cost
tools.description: Quote how many credits a REST request path costs before running it, plus the plan list. No key.

path.description: Request path with query, for example /api/v1/projections?league=NBA&limit=200
